no_adcom_quote.quote: Pembrolizumab was not referred to an advisory committee because the application did not raise significant public health questions for this indication.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the original BLA125514 (KEYTRUDA/pembrolizumab) accelerated approval. The Office Director memo, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Medical review all state the application was not referred to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) because the safety profile was acceptable, the primary efficacy outcome measures were similar to prior accelerated approvals in metastatic melanoma, and the application raised no significant public health questions. Because no AdComm was held, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
